statement: hid-wiimote v6.12 status 0x20 resets data report mode and on changed bit schedules hotplug worker, clearing extension/MP active flags on disconnect. The worker reinitializes A400 and A600, reads A600FA/6 and A400FA/6, conditionally remaps MP via A600FE 04/05/07, and requests another status. Repeated synthetic transitions risk reinit competition with SDL and hidraw; this is a source-derived risk, not an observed storm.
